notes: Product pages were found in https://www.ondemand.labcorp.com/sitemap.xml. Prices are in each page's server-rendered HTML (the price block and the add-to-cart button's data-price), so no price JSON was needed.

CPT codes: the OnDemand SKU is the Labcorp test number, and https://www.labcorp.com/tests/<sku> gives the CPT code in its page title (005009 is CPT 85025, 322000 is CPT 80053). Labcorp's test menu names 005009 'Complete Blood Count (CBC) With Differential, Reflex to Peripheral Smear Review'.
Fees: the help center articles (fetched as the help center's own article JSON) say the ordering provider's fee and sample collection are included in the price. Tax was not checked.

The CMP was on an October sale when captured: the page shows the sale price and the regular price. cashCents is the regular price; the sale price and its terms are in `sale`. The promotions article also says discounts do not apply to the physician fee, and the page shows no separate physician fee, so the exact sale total at checkout was not confirmed (no cart or checkout calls were made).
These are national online prices for ordering the test directly, with the draw at a Labcorp location. They are not tied to one location and are not hospital prices.
